Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick next steps: Acme AI webinar — demo request + SDR handoff

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for joining yesterday’s webinar and for the great questions during the Q&A. I wanted to follow up with the replay and a proposed next step to get you a personalized walkthrough.

What I can do now:
- Share the on-demand replay and attendee materials (attached).
- Get this over to our SDR team for a short discovery call + a tailored demo focused on your latency/cost questions.

If you’re interested in a demo, do any of these windows work for you next week?
- Tue 8/22 between 9–11 PT
- Wed 8/23 12–2 PT
- Thu 8/24 3–5 PT

I’ll also include the attendee extract and our MQL notes for SDR triage. If you prefer a direct intro to Solutions Engineering instead of SDR, say the word and I’ll skip the handoff.

Attachments: acme-webinar-replay-20280818.mp4 (replay link stub), acme-attendee-list-20280818.csv (attendee export)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
www.redwood.ai

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick next steps: Acme AI webinar — demo request + SDR handoff

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the follow-up and the replay.

Wed 8/23 12–2 PT works well for our team. Prefer to start with a short discovery (30m) to scope the demo: we have a priority to bring down inference cost on production models and validate KV cache behavior with our prompt patterns.

Couple of quick items for SDR to know (so you can include in the handoff):
- We run 2M monthly tokens across a mix of seq lengths; main latency sensitivity is tail p95 under load.
- Security is standard enterprise (SAML, audit logs).
- Budget: evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted; leaning Dedicated if the numbers work.

Happy to share a short slide with our current infra if helpful.

Cheers,
Jane
Senior AI Platform Engineer
Acme AI

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Please claim: Acme AI — high-priority demo request (Wed 8/23 12–2 PT)

Ben / Stephanie —

Heads-up: Acme AI (Jane Doe) responded and confirmed Wed 8/23 12–2 PT as their preferred window for a 30m discovery. They’re an MQL with the following quick score/notes (from the attached workbook):
- MQL score: 82 (high) — enterprise appetite, dedicated eval likely
- Primary pain: reduce per-token cost, p95 latency at scale
- Security: SAML + audit logs required
- Estimated ARR motion: mid-six figures if Dedicated pilot proceeds

Action items for SDR handoff (please follow the playbook):
1) Claim in HubSpot and change lifecycle to Sales Qualified Lead; add deal id RDW-4239.
2) Confirm Wed 8/23 12:00 PT slot. If claimed by only one rep, create calendar invite with zoom and include Solutions Engineering.
3) Before the call, review acme-attendee-list-20280818.csv and the acme-mql-scorecard-0819.xlsx I attached. Key fields: use "inference_scale" and "security_priority" to tailor questions.
4) If prospect asks for Dedicated cost ballpark, use the Dedicated playbook (attach conservative unit economics). Avoid quoting custom SLAs without Sales Ops.

If neither of you can cover, @Marissa can step in — Marissa, can you confirm backup?

Thanks — please mark claimed in the thread when you take it.

Tessa
